annotator: Codex; manual title/abstract review, pending human domain review

protocol.query: Diffusion-based visuomotor imitation learning for robotic manipulation
protocol.positive_rule: A paper directly studies robot visuomotor/manipulation policy learning from demonstrations or action sequences, including diffusion policy, action chunking, behavior cloning, or closely related embodied behavior generation.
protocol.negative_rule: General language-model reasoning, generic robot control without the scoped imitation-learning task, and unrelated planning/RL are negative for this query.
protocol.evidence: Title and abstract only; no clicks, impressions, popularity, or algorithm output were used to assign relevance.
protocol.candidate_pool: Union of the actual global-discovery first 5, explicit Imitation Learning recall results, and content-v1 first 8; after each captured prefix, unreturned pooled candidates are appended by stable ID for full-permutation metric input.

ranking_sources.global_discovery: HomeDiscoveryService daily order, first 5; remaining pooled candidates appended by ID.
ranking_sources.explicit_topic: KnowledgeService.search_by_subject('Imitation Learning') result order from the isolated local knowledge test fixture; remaining pooled candidates appended by ID.
ranking_sources.content-v1: RecommendationService.page for the isolated synthetic E2E account after a Diffusion Policy search and foreground PDF read; remaining pooled candidates appended by stable ID.

limitations: One query and one provisional reviewer are insufficient for a quality conclusion.
The explicit-topic and content-v1 candidate rankings were captured with a local deterministic Knowledge API fixture and mock paper catalog, not the production knowledge base.
The first five global-discovery items form a deliberately broad negative sample; this pilot is not representative of the full candidate distribution.
